page_title: Rao Edits - AI Image Generator & Photo Editor

sources.entry: Rao Edits - Generate images from text and edit reference photos for social, product, and creative workflows. #paid

summary.name: Rao Edits
summary.one_liner: Rao Edits is an AI image generation and photo editing platform that creates images from text prompts and edits photos, marketed for CapCut templates and social content.
use_cases: Generate images for CapCut video templates
Create social media visuals from text prompts
Make image variations for creative projects
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web platform where users type a text prompt to generate an image using the Nano Banana Pro and Gemini 3 Pro models. Users can then refine results with AI photo editing tools such as adjusting colors, adding effects, retouching, or creating variations. Finished images can be downloaded in high resolution. The page positions the tool for CapCut templates, social content, and product or client work, and mentions plans and models but does not list specific prices or features per plan.
notable: Built on Google's Nano Banana Pro and Gemini 3 Pro models
Text-to-image generation plus photo editing in one platform
caveats: Listed as paid in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory; the page itself does not state prices
Plans are mentioned but their details are not shown on the page
Testimonials and user counts (10K+ images, 5K+ users) are promotional and unverified
